protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Search Builder exposes RLIKE as Regex and passes the selected operator and staff-controlled value to CRM_Contact_BAO_Query::buildClause. Its RLIKE arm embeds $value inside a quoted SQL fragment without CRM_Utils_Type::escape, unlike the default valued-operator path, so a quote can escape the literal and produce CWE-89 SQL injection. CVE.org is PUBLISHED and identifies affected versions through 6.18.alpha1; GHSA withdrawn_at is null.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: PASS: a047568869892f9af65002c1709af1931f5f4b0d is the one-parent commit that first adds the dedicated RLIKE arm and its unescaped interpolation. The later 0800bc59a47fd6cfe2f4463207e9e47d7a0edfc4 changes only the field-side BINARY expression and preserves the same unsafe value interpolation.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: PASS: direct parent 8b977676304e1d83f7f8608b87b2065c38de62d3 has no RLIKE case; RLIKE therefore reaches the default branch, which calls CRM_Utils_Type::escape before quoting the string value.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: PASS: a047568869892f9af65002c1709af1931f5f4b0d is the sole ancestry-path member after its direct parent. c57fce721d8594eca18f5a12558b1ca4580a80bd is a two-parent merge whose second parent is a047568869892f9af65002c1709af1931f5f4b0d, so the merge is not the first-write BIC and no hidden squash aggregate is being substituted.

findings: Independent replay confirms the primary record's vulnerability mechanism, atomic introducer a047568869892f9af65002c1709af1931f5f4b0d, direct parent 8b977676304e1d83f7f8608b87b2065c38de62d3, and NOT_AI attribution.

remaining_gap: Upstream has not published a direct fix or fixed release for this vulnerability; this is an open remediation gap, not an evidence gap in the NOT_AI judgment.
